sections.heading: Getting Started
sections.text: A page is one Markdown file with YAML frontmatter. The frontmatter is derived from the path unless you write one; , , and shape the graph.

sections.heading: Add a page
sections.text: Create : Rebuild with and the page appears in the nav forest, the breadcrumb chain, and the frozen graph.
sections.code: content/guides/example.md --- title: Example parent: index tags: [guides] --- # Example Hello from [[index]]. boris --input content --html-dir dist --theme themes/boris

sections.heading: Frontmatter at a glance
sections.text: — page title ( , search, and metadata). — entity id of the structural parent (this page lives under ). — free-form list rendered into page metadata. — semantic edges such as ; see semantic relations. A wiki link is a real graph edge: a link to a missing page fails the build instead of rendering as dead prose.

sections.heading: Publishing
sections.text: Boris treats the deployment URL as publication truth, not an incidental detail. The starter profile declares one public HTML target: Inspect the normalized plan before publishing: The official GitHub Pages workflow (see the repository's ) builds a verified target: it resolves the Pages location from , fails on any URL projection that disagrees with it, uploads only inventory-verified files, and retains a separate evidence artifact. Atmosphere publication uses : replace the obviously-fake DID and URL before . This starter page is related to Getting Started so the semantic graph has an edge to inspect.
sections.code: { "format": "boris-publication-profile", "schema_version": 1, "input": "content", "targets": [ { "name": "public", "output": "dist", "public": true, "theme": "themes/boris" } ] } boris plan --profile boris.json boris standard-site plan --profile standard-site.json docs/github-pages.md actions/configure-pages standard-site.json standard-site publish

sections.heading: Welcome
sections.text: This is a fresh Boris documentation site. It already has a page graph: this trunk page, two guides beneath it, wiki links between them, and one semantic relation. Start here: Getting Started — add your own pages and watch the graph grow. Publishing — turn the site into a verified publication.

sections.heading: Anatomy of this starter
sections.code: boris init content/ index.md trunk page (this one) guides/getting-started.md satellite, parent: index guides/publishing.md satellite, parent: index themes/boris/ starter theme (closed layout slots) boris.json publication profile (GitHub Pages) standard-site.json Atmosphere profile (edit the fake DID/URL)
